title: Fake stationary rough Heston volatility: Microstructure-inspired foundations
summary: This paper investigates the asymptotic behavior of suitably time-modulated Hawkes processes with heavy-tailed kernels in a nearly unstable regime. We show that, under appropriate scaling, both the intensity processes and the rescaled Hawkes processes converge to a mean-reverting, time-inhomogeneous rough fractional square-root process and its integrated counterpart, respectively. In particular, when the original Hawkes process has a stationary first moment (constant marginal mean), the limiting process takes the form of a time-inhomogeneous rough fractional Cox-Ingersoll-Ross (CIR) equation…
